## Changes

* fix: canonicalize paths that don't exist in the editor service and lsp (#1260)
* feat: ensure a stable format for stdin formatting and optionally in editors (#1261)
* feat(lsp): format jupyter notebook cells (#1262)
* feat(lsp): format untitled documents (#1265)
* feat(lsp): support not using the global config by default (#1264)
* fix(lsp): do not panic on positions that are out of range (#1267)
* fix(lsp): format files outside the cwd with the global config (#1268)
* fix(lsp): apply "inherit": true in nested config files (#1269)
* fix(lsp): keep formatting with other configs after a config changes (#1270)
* fix(lsp): exit the process after the exit notification (#1272)
* fix(lsp): log formatting failures to the client (#1273)
* fix(lsp): rebuild the line index when a change ends in changed lines (#1275)
* fix(lsp): store the document version when a change is applied (#1276)
* fix(lsp): pick up gitignore changes without a config change (#1278)
* fix(lsp): correct config completion edits on incomplete input (#1279)
* fix(lsp): retry failed plugin schema downloads and limit the wait on them (#1280)
* fix(lsp): only register completion and hover for config files (#1281)

## Install

Run `dprint upgrade` or see https://dprint.dev/install/

## Verification

These artifacts have [build provenance attestations](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/security-for-github-actions/using-artifact-attestations/using-artifact-attestations-to-establish-provenance-for-builds).
Verify a download with the [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com/):

```shell
gh attestation verify dprint-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.zip --repo dprint/dprint
```
